Read by bin/model-prices-sync.sh as ${MODEL_PRICES_SYNC:-1}. The lane's own disarm, alongside flags/model-prices-sync-off: 0 leaves this box pricing from whatever state/model-prices.json it already has, or from catalog/model-prices.json if it has none. Registered by BH-1032 so the switch the script really reads is the switch the page draws.
